verdict.rationale: Cua describes itself as "Open source infrastructure for computer use agents" covering Spaces, Driver, Lume, SDK and Bench, and it has a public GitHub repository (trycua/cua), so readable source is evidenced. However, no specific open license is ever named in the pack, so the "open license" part is only implied. Missing for 10: the named license (e.g. MIT/Apache), confirmation that every component is covered, and independent corroboration of source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Open source infrastructure for computer use agents: Cua Spaces, Cua Driver, Lume, the Cua SDK and Cua Bench.
Move a signed-in app, such as Chrome or Slack, into a Space and it opens there still signed in.
